episode_title: Asked To Be Executor? Don't Say Yes Yet.

real_qa.q: How long does it take to settle a basic simple estate in Canada?
real_qa.r: In Canada, even a basic simple estate can take 12 to 18 months to resolve. Additionally, settling a simple basic estate can take 50 plus hours of time and effort to complete.
real_qa.requete: how long settle simple estate Canada

real_qa.q: What personal liability risks do executors face when distributing estate assets?
real_qa.r: If you settle an estate and distribute the residue before everything is settled, before all debts are cleared, or before receiving a clearance certificate from the CRA confirming taxes are handled properly, the executor can end up being held personally responsible and have to return those assets. This can be a heavy responsibility.
real_qa.requete: executor personal liability distributing estate Canada

real_qa.q: What is the CRA clearance certificate and why is it important for executors?
real_qa.r: A clearance certificate from the CRA confirms that taxes due on the estate have been handled properly. Executors must ensure they have this certificate before distributing the residue of the estate; otherwise, they can face personal liability if tax issues arise later.
real_qa.requete: CRA clearance certificate executor estate settlement

real_qa.q: What percentage of family members think it is unfair to be asked to serve as executor?
real_qa.r: According to a survey conducted in Canada, the vast majority of family members think that it is unfair to ask them to fill the executor role. Many are becoming more familiar with what the role entails and are starting to understand the time commitment, liability risks, and pressure involved.
real_qa.requete: survey family members executor unfair role Canada

real_qa.q: What is the Before You Say Yes tool and how does it help prospective executors?
real_qa.r: Before You Say Yes is a reflective tool created by Nancy Bouver that allows you to think about what is required to make sure you are ready to accept the executor role if you have been asked. It helps prospective executors assess their readiness before committing.
real_qa.requete: Before You Say Yes executor tool Next Steps
